name: Coconut-milk pancake
summary: The provincial tourism portal, 9 June 2021, calls bánh xèo familiar in Ben Tre and in the south. The batter is rice flour with coconut milk and a little turmeric, so the crust fries yellow. One counter fills it with clam, shrimp, pork, and cassava, and sets out rau quế vị (xá xị), mustard green, lettuce, young mango leaf, young hog-plum leaf, lá cách, and basil. The 48-hour article also names bánh xèo on the garden lunch, with no filling. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Town, on the 9 June 2021 article, and the garden lunch on the portal’s 48-hour day.
howToEat: The 9 June 2021 plate is the yellow coconut-milk crust with clam, shrimp, pork, and cassava, wrapped in the herb list above. That filling is one counter.
The garden lunch names bánh xèo and does not print a filling. Bánh xèo ốc gạo, on the 4 November 2021 overview, is a separate name.
